lines.en: Two steps, then a head bob.
The top of this skull is hard.
I walk along the brush edge.
My hind legs are sturdier.
Standing, I reach three blocks.
My tail swings behind me.
I head for those low trees.
Deep prints where I step.
Every step rattles the frame under my hide.
I walk low through the grass.
I go around that pile of stone.
I rock a little as I move.

lines.zh: 我抬头，天光落在骨板上。
lines.en: I look up; daylight lands on the dome.
These legs are strong.
I stand with my head low.
The dome is thick bone.
I listen to the grass.
An insect landed on me.
I swing my tail slowly.

lines.zh: 我拿头顶的骨板敲了敲树干。
lines.en: I rapped the tree trunk with the dome on my head.
I scuff the ground with a foot.

lines.zh: 没别的事，我拿骨板蹭树皮。
lines.en: Nothing else to do; I rub the dome on bark.

lines.zh: 我把胸口的气慢慢吐掉。
lines.en: I let the air drain slowly from my chest.
The sun has the dome hot to the touch.
My nostrils keep twitching.
I tilt my head aside to listen.

lines.zh: 远处有影子晃，我盯住它。
lines.en: Something shifts far off; I fix on it.
I like it beside this stone.
Your skull isn't thick enough.
This head is very hard.
Don't stand right in front of me.
Step away when I lower my head.

lines.zh: 你身上连片硬东西都没有。
lines.en: There's not a hard plate anywhere on you.
I'm quite a bit taller than you.
Looking at my dome?
My temper isn't bad.
Why are you picking that up?
I eat leaves here.
Just stand still.
Keep your hand off the dome.
That didn't crack the dome.
There's a cut on my leg.

lines.zh: 我晃着退后，又稳住身子。
lines.en: I stagger back, then steady myself.
Blood seeps through the hide.
I rocked my head.

lines.zh: 脑壳里嗡了一声，眼前发花。
lines.en: My skull rings and my sight swims.

lines.zh: 我从喉咙里挤出一声闷吼。
lines.en: A muffled bellow is forced out of my throat.

lines.zh: 血止住了，口子慢慢收拢。
lines.en: The bleeding stops and the gash draws shut.

lines.zh: 四只脚还钉在地上，没退。
lines.en: All four feet are still planted, unshifted.

lines.zh: 你的棍子砸在骨板上，手该麻了。
lines.en: Your club hit the dome; your hands must be numb.
Is that leaves?
I don't much eat that.
Bring it closer. I can't tell.
I'll lower my head. Don't step back.
I don't know that smell.
I prefer what's on the branch.
Put it down. Let me smell it.
Are you trying to draw me over?
I don't need that much.
Keep it. I'm going.
My head met you.
You didn't hold your ground.
I'm not easily pushed aside.
Don't press against my flank.
Dome meets dome, and we both rock.

lines.zh: 隔着这么厚的皮，我几乎没感觉。
lines.en: Through hide this thick, I barely feel it.
The stone took a knock too.
Your armor dented.
I lower my head and aim the dome at you.
Step back and I'll walk on.
We butt heads, both of us.
Not a fight. The other thing.
Don't stand nearby.
Its dome is flatter than mine.
We knocked a few times, then stopped.
The grass is all churned.
Afterwards it goes into the trees.
There'll be young ones here this year.
Neither of us got hurt.
The sound carried a fair way.
I bite off a branch.
I pick a stone up in my mouth.
There are some fruits on the ground.
I chewed and spat it out.
It bites like a chunk of rock.

lines.zh: 我一脚下去，它就散成渣。
lines.en: One stamp and it crumbles to bits.
My claws aren't nimble.

lines.zh: 你掉的那东西在我脚下。
lines.en: What you dropped is under my feet.

lines.zh: 我用嘴把它拱到草丛里。
lines.en: I nudge it into the grass with my snout.

lines.zh: 这个闻着能吃，我尝一口。
lines.en: That smells edible; I'll try a bite.
You're standing dead in front of me.
I saw you move.
My head is down.
I'll come at you.
Don't stand behind that stone.
You're on my path.
This charge isn't a game.
Back off and you can still leave.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸从灌木那边传过来。
lines.en: Your breathing carries from behind the brush.
This brush won't stop me.

lines.zh: 我先迈出一步，骨板压低。
lines.en: I take the first step, dome lowered.
You raised that first.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，量还剩几步。
lines.en: I watch your feet and count the steps left.
Your footing is bad.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，慢慢缀着你。
lines.en: Stop and start, I trail after you.
You backed toward the brush.
I see your head above the grass.

lines.zh: 我低了低头，下一秒就撞。
lines.en: I dip my head; next second I charge.

lines.zh: 你绕了一圈，又回到原处。
lines.en: You circled once and came back to the same spot.
Not fast, until I get going.
The ground there is flat.
There's a ridge ahead.

lines.zh: 你改了三次方向，我都跟着。
lines.en: You changed course three times; I followed each.

lines.zh: 我低着头，骨板朝前顶着。
lines.en: Head low, dome pointed at you.

lines.zh: 这片空地没有东西能挡你。
lines.en: There's nothing on this flat ground to shield you.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经盖到你脚上。
lines.en: My shadow has reached your feet.

lines.zh: 你听见脚踏地面的声吗？
lines.en: Hear those feet on the ground?
I'm already starting forward.
The stones will trip you.

lines.zh: 我把整个身子压进这一顶。
lines.en: I put my whole weight behind this butt.
That's a lot of weight.
You were lifted off your feet.
The dome cracked against you.
After the hit I saw stars.
My neck is twisted a little.
You went back several blocks.

lines.zh: 撞完我甩头，把晕劲甩掉。
lines.en: After the hit I shake the dizziness loose.
That one rang right through my neck.
You're on the ground, panting.

lines.zh: 我的角没有，全靠这块骨。
lines.en: No horns. Just this bone.

lines.zh: 地面被我们撞出一个坑。
lines.en: We knocked a pit in the ground.
You haven't got up.
Another and I won't be able to stop.
I come out from behind the brush.
Deep prints under me.

lines.zh: 我抬起厚重的头，认这片地。
lines.en: I lift my heavy head and read this ground.
There's food in this patch.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候地震了一下。
lines.en: The ground shook when I landed.
I came from the laboratory side.
I still smell of soil.
I push myself up out of the dirt.
The daylight is sharp.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴一抖，土块落下。
lines.en: I shake my tail and clods of dirt fall.
The wind is gentle here.
I found that stone.

lines.zh: 树影分开，我一步一步走出来。
lines.en: The shade parts and I step out of it.
The grass bends where I land.
First I took stock of this ground.
I still smell of the laboratory.

lines.zh: 我缓缓转了一圈，看清四周。
lines.en: I turn a slow circle and take in the ground.
It's brighter here than I remember.

lines.zh: 火烧到背脊，我甩头想甩掉。
lines.en: Fire on my spine; I shake my head to throw it off.

lines.zh: 这个重量摔下来，腿一软。
lines.en: This weight landing buckled my legs.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我站不稳。
lines.en: Water over my back. I can't stand.
The blast threw up the earth.
The arrow went barely into the hide.
That light went round my dome.
No leaves, no strength.

lines.zh: 雷打在骨板上，我一下就晕了。
lines.en: Lightning hit the dome and I blacked out.

lines.zh: 脚下空空的，我四条腿乱蹬。
lines.en: Nothing under me; my four legs thrash.
